description: Classify PM2.5, PM10, CO2, and VOC readings into WHO 2021 / EPA / ASHRAE / UBA health bands. Pass readings directly, or omit them and the tool will fetch the current reading from the default provider (PM2.5, PM10, CO2, VOC where available). Returns per-pollutant band + the worst signal across pollutants + deduplicated recommended actions + source citations.

co2.description: CO2 in ppm. If omitted, pulled from air_current_reading.

locationId.description: Provider-specific location id for fetch fallback.

pm10.description: PM10 in µg/m³. If omitted, pulled from air_current_reading.

pm25.description: PM2.5 in µg/m³. If omitted, pulled from air_current_reading.

privacy_mode.description: Optional privacy mode: summary | structured | raw. summary omits location identifiers and device serials when present; structured/raw return full payload.

provider.description: Provider for fetch fallback. Defaults to airgradient.

voc.description: tVOC in ppb. If omitted, pulled from air_current_reading.tvoc when present.

name: air_health_bands
title: Air health bands
